rationale: The papers 'Further evidence for a population of dark-matter-deficient dwarf galaxies' and 'Rotation Curves in z~1-2 Star-Forming Disks: Evidence for Cored Dark Matter Distributions' provide evidence relevant to the mass profiles and rotation curves of galaxies, contributing to the understanding of the question regarding dark matter models.
